name: cohrs1
label: Number of hours partner worked last week

questions.text:
Last week was your (partner) working full time, part time, going to school, keeping house, or what?
 A. IF WORKING, FULL OR PART TIME:  How many hours did (he/she) work last week, at all jobs?
